items.title: Bitcoin tumbles below $76,000 as post-election stock rally fades
items.summary:
Bitcoin (BTC-USD) tumbled below $76,000 on Thursday as investors moved out of riskier assets amid a broad sell-off in US stocks that threatened to erase the previous day's post-election rally.

The world's largest cryptocurrency fell 5% Thursday, reversing a sharp rebound Wednesday that had lifted bitcoin above $80,000 as investors cheered midterm election results showing Democrats swept both chambers of Congress. [...] Bitcoin's latest slide follows a warning from digital asset research firm K33 earlier this week that unusually thin trading activity and rising use of leverage set up bitcoin for sharp price swings following midterm results.

Bitcoin's retreat also underscored of the crypto market's lingering fragility following $6.3 billion hack of Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, which rattled crypto prices last week.

items.title: It is hard to believe, but 66,000 GitHub stars went to a way of running Claude Code without paying Anthropic
items.summary:
It is hard to believe, but 66,000 GitHub stars went to a way of running Claude Code without paying Anthropic

1. Open https://t.co/SEPe3iMvH2, on Mac or Linux run the curl installer from the README

2. Run fcc-server on Linux or open the Free Claude Code app on Mac and Windows, it opens the Admin UI

3. Turn on Proxy Authentication with your own token, by default the proxy is open to your whole network

4. Create an API key at https://t.co/LgVWtkHqC6, paste it under Providers, NVIDIA NIM, Add key, Save, then click Apply

5. Start the agent with fcc-claude

6. Switch in the native /model picker among providers you set up, 61 in the catalog, free and paid, DeepSeek, Kimi, Groq, Ollama

7. Add Fallback Models so a dead provider rolls to the next one, a failed request can consume usage from more than one

Free routes mean other models, not Claude, Anthropic does not support this, and your code goes to the provider unless it is local

The README claims 1.3B+ free tokens a month, availability and limits are set by each provider and can change

Full guide in the article below
